brief.aim: The table holds seven homogeneous numeric kernel geometry measurements (area, perimeter, compactness, kernel length/width, asymmetry, groove length) with no outcome column, so the evident aim is segmenting kernels into natural groups; no column is an identifier or a target derivative.
brief.repeated_subjects: No repeated subjects expected; each row is a distinct kernel.
brief.unit: one wheat kernel seed (row of seven geometric measurements)
